scope: Initial PSP runtime-oracle proof set; these contracts distinguish Script VM control status from script-command inputs and outputs.

interpreter_abi.nonzero_status: Stops the current Process() pass; its exact reason is command-specific.
interpreter_abi.important_distinction: A native handler status is not an SCM script-command return value or output.

opcodes.name: NOP
opcodes.native_handler_status_meaning: Continue executing the next opcode in the same Process() pass.

static_evidence.psp: 0x002B73E0: jr ra; delay slot or v0, zero, zero
static_evidence.ps2: 0x003B1448: jr ra; delay slot move v0, zero

opcodes.name: WAIT
side_effects: updates ScriptThread wake_time
opcodes.native_handler_status_meaning: Stops this Process() pass; for WAIT this is a yield until wake_time.

opcodes.name: GOTO
side_effects: updates ScriptThread script_ip
opcodes.native_handler_status_meaning: Continue executing from the new script IP in the same Process() pass.

opcodes.name: SET_VAR_INT
side_effects: stores one raw dword in the destination variable

opcodes.name: SET_VAR_FLOAT
side_effects: stores one raw dword in the destination variable

opcodes.name: SET_VAR_TEXT_LABEL
side_effects: stores one raw dword in the destination variable
opcodes.boundary: A literal string is modeled as a ScriptSpace offset; no host string-pointer ABI is claimed.

opcodes.name: ADD_VAL_TO_INT_VAR
side_effects: adds one raw int32 value to the destination modulo 2^32

opcodes.name: ADD_VAL_TO_FLOAT_VAR
side_effects: adds one binary32 value to the destination and stores the resulting raw binary32 dword

opcodes.name: SUB_VAL_FROM_INT_VAR
side_effects: subtracts one int32 value from the destination modulo 2^32

opcodes.name: SUB_VAL_FROM_FLOAT_VAR
side_effects: subtracts one binary32 value from the destination and stores the resulting raw binary32 dword

opcodes.name: MULT_INT_VAR_BY_VAL
side_effects: multiplies destination by one int32 value and stores the low 32 result bits

opcodes.name: MULT_FLOAT_VAR_BY_VAL
side_effects: multiplies destination by one binary32 value and stores the resulting raw binary32 dword

opcodes.name: DIV_INT_VAR_BY_VAL
side_effects: divides destination by one int32 value for normal operands
opcodes.boundary: The portable core faults for divisor zero and INT_MIN/-1 rather than asserting a portable quotient for native hardware edge cases.

opcodes.name: DIV_FLOAT_VAR_BY_VAL
side_effects: divides destination by one binary32 value and stores the resulting raw binary32 dword

opcodes.name: IS_INT_VAR_GREATER_THAN_NUMBER
side_effects: reduces signed param[0] > param[1] into ScriptThread condition_result

opcodes.name: IS_NUMBER_GREATER_THAN_INT_VAR
side_effects: reduces signed param[0] > param[1] into ScriptThread condition_result

opcodes.name: IS_INT_VAR_GREATER_THAN_INT_VAR
side_effects: reduces signed param[0] > param[1] into ScriptThread condition_result

opcodes.name: IS_FLOAT_VAR_GREATER_THAN_NUMBER
side_effects: reduces !(param[0] <= param[1]) into ScriptThread condition_result

opcodes.name: IS_NUMBER_GREATER_THAN_FLOAT_VAR
side_effects: reduces !(param[0] <= param[1]) into ScriptThread condition_result

opcodes.name: IS_FLOAT_VAR_GREATER_THAN_FLOAT_VAR
side_effects: reduces !(param[0] <= param[1]) into ScriptThread condition_result

opcodes.name: IS_INT_VAR_GREATER_OR_EQUAL_TO_NUMBER
side_effects: reduces signed param[0] >= param[1] into ScriptThread condition_result

opcodes.name: IS_NUMBER_GREATER_OR_EQUAL_TO_INT_VAR
side_effects: reduces signed param[0] >= param[1] into ScriptThread condition_result

opcodes.name: IS_INT_VAR_GREATER_OR_EQUAL_TO_INT_VAR
side_effects: reduces signed param[0] >= param[1] into ScriptThread condition_result

opcodes.name: IS_FLOAT_VAR_GREATER_OR_EQUAL_TO_NUMBER
side_effects: reduces !(param[0] < param[1]) into ScriptThread condition_result

opcodes.name: IS_NUMBER_GREATER_OR_EQUAL_TO_FLOAT_VAR
side_effects: reduces !(param[0] < param[1]) into ScriptThread condition_result

opcodes.name: IS_FLOAT_VAR_GREATER_OR_EQUAL_TO_FLOAT_VAR
side_effects: reduces !(param[0] < param[1]) into ScriptThread condition_result

opcodes.name: IS_INT_VAR_EQUAL_TO_NUMBER
side_effects: reduces param[0] == param[1] into ScriptThread condition_result

opcodes.name: IS_INT_VAR_EQUAL_TO_INT_VAR
side_effects: reduces param[0] == param[1] into ScriptThread condition_result

opcodes.name: IS_FLOAT_VAR_EQUAL_TO_NUMBER
inputs: two encoded raw binary32 parameter dwords
side_effects: reduces raw param[0] bit equality with param[1] into ScriptThread condition_result

opcodes.name: IS_FLOAT_VAR_EQUAL_TO_FLOAT_VAR
inputs: two encoded raw binary32 parameter dwords
side_effects: reduces raw param[0] bit equality with param[1] into ScriptThread condition_result

opcodes.name: GOTO_IF_FALSE
side_effects: updates ScriptThread script_ip only if condition_result is false
opcodes.native_handler_status_meaning: Continue with either the retained next IP or the false-branch target.

opcodes.name: START_NEW_SCRIPT
side_effects: clamps negative script index to zero
creates a host-managed child ScriptThread
copies 96 raw dword locals at child local slot zero
opcodes.native_handler_status_meaning: Continue the parent thread after the child was created and initialized.
opcodes.boundary: The child factory, lifetime and entry-IP initialization belong to the host adapter; the VM-owned consumption is exactly 1 + 96 encoded parameters.

opcodes.name: GOSUB
side_effects: pushes a tagless post-parameter return IP
increments call-stack depth
updates ScriptThread script_ip
opcodes.native_handler_status_meaning: Continue executing from the GOSUB target in the same Process() pass.

opcodes.name: RETURN
side_effects: pops GOSUB or function frame
restores script_ip
function frames may store caller outputs and roll back locals
opcodes.native_handler_status_meaning: Continue executing at the restored return IP in the same Process() pass.

opcodes.name: ADD_INT_VAR_TO_INT_VAR
side_effects: adds one raw int32 value to the destination modulo 2^32

opcodes.name: ARITHMETIC_DISPATCH_ALIAS_FLOAT_ADD
side_effects: same direct native handler as 0008: binary32 add and raw-result store

opcodes.name: ARITHMETIC_DISPATCH_ALIAS_INTEGER_SUBTRACT
side_effects: same direct native handler as 0009: int32 subtraction modulo 2^32

opcodes.name: ARITHMETIC_DISPATCH_ALIAS_FLOAT_SUBTRACT
side_effects: same direct native handler as 000A: binary32 subtraction and raw-result store

opcodes.name: ARITHMETIC_DISPATCH_ALIAS_INTEGER_MULTIPLY
side_effects: same direct native handler as 000B: stores low 32 product bits

opcodes.name: ARITHMETIC_DISPATCH_ALIAS_FLOAT_MULTIPLY
side_effects: same direct native handler as 000C: binary32 multiplication and raw-result store

opcodes.name: ARITHMETIC_DISPATCH_ALIAS_INTEGER_DIVIDE
side_effects: same direct native handler as 000D: signed division for normal operands

opcodes.name: ARITHMETIC_DISPATCH_ALIAS_FLOAT_DIVIDE
side_effects: same direct native handler as 000E: binary32 division and raw-result store

opcodes.name: ADD_TIMED_VAL_TO_FLOAT_VAR
side_effects: multiplies the value by the engine time-step scalar
adds the binary32 delta to destination and stores raw result bits
opcodes.boundary: 0031 and 0032 are exact shared-target aliases on both platforms. The engine time-step scalar is host-provided in the portable core.

opcodes.name: ADD_TIMED_FLOAT_VAR_TO_FLOAT_VAR
side_effects: multiplies the value by the engine time-step scalar
adds the binary32 delta to destination and stores raw result bits
opcodes.boundary: Exact dispatch alias of 0031 on PSP and PS2; no unique source-kind parameter ABI is claimed beyond the shared decoder path.

opcodes.name: SUB_TIMED_VAL_FROM_FLOAT_VAR
side_effects: multiplies the value by the engine time-step scalar
subtracts the binary32 delta from destination and stores raw result bits
opcodes.boundary: 0033 and 0034 are exact shared-target aliases on both platforms. The engine time-step scalar is host-provided in the portable core.

opcodes.name: SUB_TIMED_FLOAT_VAR_FROM_FLOAT_VAR
side_effects: multiplies the value by the engine time-step scalar
subtracts the binary32 delta from destination and stores raw result bits
opcodes.boundary: Exact dispatch alias of 0033 on PSP and PS2; no unique source-kind parameter ABI is claimed beyond the shared decoder path.

opcodes.name: SET_VAR_INT_TO_VAR_INT
side_effects: stores one raw dword in the destination variable

opcodes.name: SET_VAR_FLOAT_TO_VAR_FLOAT
side_effects: stores one raw dword in the destination variable

opcodes.name: SET_VAR_TEXT_LABEL_TO_VAR_TEXT_LABEL
side_effects: stores one raw dword in the destination variable
opcodes.boundary: Exact PSP/PS2 dispatch alias of 0006. The direct handler is raw-dword assignment; this does not assert a host string-pointer representation.

opcodes.name: CSET_VAR_INT_TO_VAR_FLOAT
side_effects: stores source truncated toward zero as int32 in destination
opcodes.boundary: NaN, infinity and out-of-int32-range input fault explicitly in the portable core; native FPU-invalid payload is not asserted.

opcodes.name: CSET_VAR_FLOAT_TO_VAR_INT
side_effects: stores the binary32 representation of source int32 in destination

opcodes.name: ABS_INT
side_effects: conditionally negates variable modulo 2^32; INT_MIN remains INT_MIN

opcodes.name: ABS_FLOAT
side_effects: negates only values strictly below +0.0; preserves -0 and unordered NaN input bits

opcodes.name: IS_CHAR_STILL_ALIVE
side_effects: queries host character liveness predicate
applies raw NOT and exact shared condition reducer
opcodes.boundary: Pool lookup, character layout and liveness predicate are engine-owned; the VM owns decode, NOT handling and condition aggregation.

opcodes.name: CHARACTER_COORDINATE_PLACEMENT_BRIDGE
inputs: three encoded IEEE-754 binary32 coordinate payloads
side_effects: resolves character through a host pool
for z == -100.0f or z <= -250.0f requests ground-height resolution
passes the resulting placement through a host character-coordinate path
opcodes.boundary: The vector-preparation, ground-height and character placement callees are engine-owned. The portable adapter receives raw payloads plus the directly proved ground-height sentinel decision.

opcodes.name: VEHICLE_DELETE_BRIDGE
side_effects: resolves the handle through a host vehicle pool
when native +0x20A is nonzero invokes the observed cleanup path
removes a non-null vehicle entity and references through host-owned paths
opcodes.boundary: The original vehicle-pool, conditional cleanup-list and entity lifetime APIs are not source-named from this proof. The portable adapter receives the raw handle and observed native +0x20A context bit.

opcodes.name: RETURN_TRUE
side_effects: applies base true through the condition reducer
pops a GOSUB or function frame
opcodes.native_handler_status_meaning: Continue at the restored return IP after setting/reducing condition state.

opcodes.name: CLEAR_PRINTS_BRIDGE
side_effects: invokes one host-owned native UI/print clear path
opcodes.boundary: The native clear callee has no recovered source-level owner name. The portable core records only the no-parameter bridge.

opcodes.name: RETURN_FALSE
side_effects: applies base false through the condition reducer
pops a GOSUB or function frame
opcodes.native_handler_status_meaning: Continue at the restored return IP after setting/reducing condition state.

opcodes.name: IF
side_effects: sets uint16 condition_state
for nonzero count seeds condition_result for AND/OR aggregation
opcodes.native_handler_status_meaning: Continue into the following condition commands in the same Process() pass.

opcodes.name: LAUNCH_MISSION
side_effects: resolves a host-owned target script object
sets the observed target launch-request byte
opcodes.native_handler_status_meaning: Continue executing the source script in the same Process() pass.
opcodes.boundary: Mission lookup, target lifetime and servicing of the observed +0x20A request are engine-owned. The portable name mission_launch_requested is an analogue, not an asserted native source-field name.

opcodes.name: IS_BUTTON_PRESSED
side_effects: narrows both inputs to uint16 in source order
queries a host input predicate
applies raw NOT and the exact shared condition reducer
opcodes.boundary: The VM proves two low-16-bit arguments and condition aggregation only. Their controller/button semantics and live input state are host-owned.

opcodes.name: SET_FADING_COLOUR
side_effects: narrows each input to low uint8
calls host fade colour adapter

opcodes.name: DO_FADE
side_effects: normalizes duration <=2 to 0.0f otherwise binary32 duration*0.001f
sign-narrows mode to int16
calls host fade-start adapter

opcodes.name: GET_FADING_STATUS
side_effects: queries host fade-status predicate
applies raw NOT and exact shared condition reducer

opcodes.name: PLAYER_STATE_CODE_TWO_CONDITION
side_effects: resolves player through a host table
compares recovered native state byte to literal 2
applies raw NOT and exact shared condition reducer
opcodes.boundary: State byte value 2 is directly proved; its source-level meaning is deliberately not asserted by the portable VM or symbol map.

opcodes.name: CHARACTER_DEAD_CONDITION
side_effects: queries host implementation of the recovered multi-branch character dead-state predicate
applies raw NOT and exact shared condition reducer
opcodes.boundary: Null/entity-type/status branches and their numeric status meanings are direct native evidence but remain host-owned rather than binary layout in the portable VM.

opcodes.name: GET_GAME_TIMER
side_effects: copies game-clock scalar to ScriptParams[0]
uses StoreParameters(1) to write destination
opcodes.boundary: The clock provider is already an injected VM host dependency for WAIT; its raw dword is preserved without a numeric conversion.

opcodes.name: PLAYER_CONTROL_BRIDGE
side_effects: resolves param[0] through an engine player table
uses only zero/non-zero semantics of param[1] to select host player-control paths
opcodes.boundary: Native player safety, camera and reset behavior is complex and engine-owned. The portable adapter receives only the directly proved player selector and boolean normalization.

opcodes.name: VEHICLE_RELEASE_MARK_BRIDGE
side_effects: resolves the handle through a host vehicle-pool path
invokes the distinct native vehicle release-mark path
when native thread+0x20A is nonzero invokes an additional host context-cleanup path
opcodes.boundary: The release policy, vehicle-pool ownership, context cleanup and original helper spellings remain host-owned. This bridge is deliberately distinct from destructive opcode 0049.

opcodes.name: GOSUB_FILE
side_effects: consumes both parameter encodings
pushes a tagless post-parameter return IP
uses only parameter[0] as script target
updates ScriptThread script_ip
opcodes.native_handler_status_meaning: Continue executing from parameter[0]'s target in the same Process() pass.
opcodes.boundary: Parameter[1] is proven consumed but unused by the handler. Its file/loader meaning is intentionally not claimed.

opcodes.name: DISPLAY_TEXT
inputs: two encoded raw binary32 coordinate payloads
one separately encoded raw text-key/offset payload
side_effects: resolves text through a host-owned GXT/text path
queues bounded UTF-16 display text
opcodes.boundary: The VM owns the two-then-one decoding order. Text-key interpretation, queue lifetime, styling and rendering remain host integration work.

opcodes.name: SCRIPT_NAME
side_effects: copies exactly eight bytes with strncpy semantics into ScriptThread script-name field
converts ASCII A..Z to lowercase in all eight bytes
opcodes.boundary: The portable core represents only safe ScriptSpace-relative sources; malformed pointer-like values fault explicitly instead of claiming native behavior.

opcodes.name: CLEAR_HELP
side_effects: ensures host help/HUD manager availability
executes the native two-path help clear sequence
opcodes.boundary: Host owns UI-manager allocation, the two native clear channels and the PS2-only internal constant flag's meaning.

opcodes.name: LOAD_AND_LAUNCH_MISSION_INTERNAL
side_effects: conditional host-mode selector remap or no-op
streams a host table-selected script slice
creates and marks a target script
updates host mission context
immediately processes target script
opcodes.boundary: This is deliberately not a portable-core handler: exact host table/buffer/factory/global/re-entrant scheduling contracts still need reconstruction.

opcodes.name: IS_INT_VAR_EQUAL_TO_CONSTANT
side_effects: reduces param[0] == param[1] into ScriptThread condition_result

opcodes.name: SET_VAR_INT_TO_CONSTANT
side_effects: stores one raw dword in the destination variable

opcodes.name: GET_PAD_STATE
outputs: raw selected pad state for selectors 0..44; otherwise selector unchanged
side_effects: uses native unsigned range 0..44
calls host pad-state adapter only in range
uses StoreParameters(1) for output
opcodes.boundary: The 45 accessor meanings are input-system owned. VM-owned behavior includes range check, out-of-range pass-through and one output-destination transfer.

opcodes.name: CALL_NOT
side_effects: updates call-frame data
increments call-stack depth
updates script_ip
opcodes.native_handler_status_meaning: Continue executing the called script path in the same Process() pass.

opcodes.name: CALL
side_effects: updates call-frame data
increments call-stack depth
updates script_ip
opcodes.native_handler_status_meaning: Continue executing the called script path in the same Process() pass.

opcodes.name: DISABLE_PAUSE_MENU
side_effects: normalizes parameter to zero/non-zero
forwards false/true to the host-owned pause-menu setter path
opcodes.boundary: The VM owns one-parameter collection and boolean normalization. Menu-object lifetime, implementation and any source-level member spelling remain host integration work.

opcodes.name: IS_THIS_SCRIPT_A_MISSION
side_effects: reads active ScriptThread native +0x217 marker
applies raw NOT and the exact shared condition reducer
opcodes.boundary: Portable is_mission_script is a semantic analogue for the VM-proven byte, not an asserted original member name.

opcodes.name: GLOBAL_BYTE_STORE_BRIDGE
side_effects: uses param[0] as an offset into an engine-owned byte region
stores low uint8(param[1])
opcodes.boundary: The global byte region has a stable native address calculation but no asserted source-level subsystem name. The portable adapter receives exactly the raw offset and narrowed byte.

opcodes.name: OPCODE_055A
side_effects: applies the raw opcode NOT bit to an engine predicate
updates Script VM condition_result (+0x209) through the proven AND/OR reducer
decrements and, on the proven OR terminal path, clears condition_state (+0x206)
opcodes.native_handler_status_meaning: Continue executing the next opcode in the same Process() pass.
opcodes.boundary: The engine predicate feeding the reducer is still unnamed and host-provided.
